subject: pri-info
title: (R)PRI.INFO.------ MTA.RT.SIGN.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-20 (Aspect Essence / Perception Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's claim about composite-focused activism: 'the effectiveness of a given intention can permeate the total lining of its culture and culture imprint. The seeds underlying a given composite activist participation can move to redirect an entire culture, and in doing so, serve as a positive factor for reunification — and hopefully, later, even cultural greatness.' (R)PRI-INFO (the reality of principle information) is crossed with MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance): the question is what principle-information produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with meta-reality-significance — the (R) prefix marking that real principle-information is what carries the cultural-redirection seed Braxton describes. MTA-RT-SIGN sits at the top. A second line from the subject runs to COS-P (cosmic particulars) and on to (PO)SG (the point of source initiation). T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and PHY-C branch down from that line before COS-P, and PHY-C continues to RT-DY (reality dynamics). (P-IN)TH-CONT-DY (its position in thrust continuance dynamics) hangs from COS-P on a *dashed* line. RT-DY anchors the lower-right margin.
